summary: OpenAI released version 3.4.0 of its Python SDK, adding API fields for chat completion chunk obfuscation and project residency/cost configuration, alongside several security and reliability bug fixes.

practices.reason: Teams should upgrade the SDK to pick up security fixes affecting WebSocket redirect handling and TLS hostname preservation.
practices.quote: apply consistent origin checks to WebSocket redirects

practices.reason: New API fields for project residency configuration and cost quantity units add optional parameters developers may want to adopt but are not required changes.
practices.quote: add project residency configuration and cost quantity units
